description: This file defines the LocationMenuConfigurator class, which implements the MenuConfigurator interface to set up menu configurations related to location views within the OrangeHRM Admin plugin. It utilizes traits for module and screen helper functions and contains a method to override the current screen to 'viewLocations'.

classes.name: LocationMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Configures menu settings related to location views in the OrangeHRM Admin module. Implements the MenuConfigurator interface and overrides the screen to 'viewLocations'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current screen to 'viewLocations' for the given Screen object, returning null.
